scope: BLOCKER-SUPPORT-001. Privacy-safe account-owned diagnostic reference: an opaque reference token plus operational support information (build id, lifecycle category, jurisdiction, counts) with no report content, document names, credentials, payment tokens or legal-source identifiers. Lookup is authenticated and ownership-scoped. No external transmission. Implementation is closed by ay-consumer-support; staging verification is pending.

tests.expected: the account receives a stable, opaque, usable diagnostic reference
tests.measured: reference matches /^crp-ref-[0-9a-f]{24}$/ and is stable across two requests

tests.expected: no report content, document names, credentials, payment tokens or legal-source identifiers appear in the support output
tests.measured: support view carries only the safe operational field set; "john-smith" filename, session token, checkout reference and adapter_id/source_entry_id are absent

tests.expected: support lookup is authenticated and ownership-scoped
tests.measured: unauthenticated -> 401; another account's reference -> 404; unknown reference -> 404; owner lookup -> 200

tests.expected: support can identify the build and the lifecycle category without private content
tests.measured: build_id and category present; a fresh account reports NO_CASE; a result-bearing account reports RESULT_PRESENT with jurisdiction
